fields.name: mission_work_in_world
fields.label: What are you trying to do in the world?
fields.description: Describe your work in simple, direct terms.

fields.name: mission_main_activities
fields.label: What are the main activities or approaches you plan to use?
fields.description: Examples include mentorship, education or training, workforce development, counseling or healing support, community-building, and advocacy.

fields.name: mission_who_for
fields.label: Who are you doing this work for?
fields.description: Be consistent with your Who We Serve section.

fields.name: mission_group_importance
fields.label: What makes this group important to focus on?

fields.name: mission_difference
fields.label: What difference does your work make in people's lives?
fields.description: Think about what is different because your work exists, what changes for individuals or families, and what improves in the community.

fields.name: mission_missing_without_work
fields.label: If your work did not exist, what would be missing?

fields.name: mission_success_3_years
fields.label: If your work is successful, what will be different 3-5 years from now?

fields.name: mission_unique_approach
fields.label: What is unique about how you approach this work?
fields.description: Examples include lived experience, a community-based approach, culturally responsive work, long-term relationships instead of short-term programs, or combining multiple supports.

fields.name: mission_effective_approach
fields.label: Why do you believe your approach will be effective?

fields.name: mission_pulling_together
fields.label: In your own words, describe what you do, for whom, and the difference it makes.

fields.name: mission_final_statement
fields.label: Write or paste your preferred mission statement draft.
fields.description: Aim for one clear sentence. This can evolve later.
